indexes.expression: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_branch_code_unique ON public.roles USING btree (school_id, branch_id, code) WHERE ((school_id IS NOT NULL) AND (branch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX roles_global_code_unique ON public.roles USING btree (code) WHERE ((school_id IS NULL) AND (branch_id IS NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
